topics.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy one million Starmind orbital data centers
topics.summary: The FCC's Space Bureau granted SpaceX authority for a constellation of one million satellites operating as orbital data centers, in shells between 500 and 1,002 km. The order sets deployment deadlines running to November 25, 2040 and addresses objections on interference and orbital congestion.

topics.title: European Commission proposes Quantum Act and a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund
topics.summary: The Commission proposed the Quantum Act and laid groundwork for a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund. Bits&Chips reports the fund would use EU seed capital to attract private investors, with 50 billion euros as a fundraising ambition, and would focus mainly on AI and quantum companies.

topics.title: Xpeng shows production-ready Iron humanoid robot and sets Q2 2027 release
topics.summary: At its AI Day in Guangzhou on November 25, Xpeng unveiled its Turing Physical AI Architecture (VLA 3.0) and a production-ready Iron humanoid robot that walked on stage autonomously. Xpeng targets an official Iron release in the second quarter of 2027, alongside paid smart driving subscriptions.
